svg.title: Thirteen-landmark keyboard map
svg.desc: A keyboard from C4 to C5 with all thirteen pitches marked, each in its own fixed identity colour, above an exact ruler from 0 to 12 semitones: P1 0, m2 1, M2 2, m3 3, M3 4, P4 5, A4/d5 6, P5 7, m6 8, M6 9, m7 10, M7 11, P8 12. Plogger marks apply to 1 through 11; 0 and 12 are boundaries.

g.text: Chips under the ruler are the Plogger [n] marks, explained in the Plogger section below; 0 and 12 are N/A boundaries.
C4 to B4 is 11 semitones. B4 to C5 is a different step of 1 semitone. Colours are artistic labels; the numbers and
